verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Xero has developer APIs, an OpenAPI spec, and SDKs for building integrations, but nothing documents a user-facing bulk data export or account portability feature that would let an end user extract all their accounting data in an open format and leave. The API access is aimed at building apps/integrations, not full data export for departure, and there's no CSV/full-ledger export or account-closure data dump mentioned anywhere in the pack.
